About

Curiosity to Creation

Hi, I’m Sarayu, a Computer Science graduate from Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bengaluru. My work lives at the intersection of full-stack development, AI, and data-driven problem solving.

At HashedIn by Deloitte, I built Compass: a desktop application that connects product-management workflows with AI assistants and enterprise tools.

From simulated audiences to adaptive recommendations, my focus is to build useful software, understand the details, and keep learning along the way.

Research

Ideas, Put Into Words

Four co-authored publications across deep learning, urban systems, and language processing.

2026Journal article

ECG Analysis for Myocardial Infarction Detection via Deep Learning ↗

Procedia Computer Science · Volume 283, pp. 866–875

Explores ECG image classification with EfficientNet-B0, multi-scale attention, and explainability methods including Grad-CAM and Integrated Gradients.

Publisher ↗ResearchGate ↗
2025Book chapter

Transforming Urban Parking: Intelligent System for a Better City Experience ↗

Springer · ICT: Applications and Social Interfaces, pp. 293–306

Proposes grid-based parking management with short- and long-term allocation, duration extensions, and Dijkstra’s algorithm for efficient assignment.

Publisher ↗ResearchGate ↗
2025Conference paper

Efficient Parking Spot Allocation in a Grid-Based Parking Lot ↗

IEEE · International Conference on Computing for Sustainability and Intelligent Future (COMP-SIF)

Studies parking-space allocation within a grid-based parking lot, connecting algorithmic problem solving with an everyday urban challenge.

Publisher ↗ResearchGate ↗
2024Conference paper

Implementing a Multilingual Lexical Analyser for Java, C and C++ ↗

IEEE · 5th Global Conference for Advancement in Technology (GCAT)

Designs a lexical analyser that categorizes source-code tokens across Java, C, and C++, presenting the results in a symbol table.
